draft.subject: One next step for Quartz Logistics
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Following up on my note last week — you've already got a first project created, which is the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, with tasks living inside them. A common next step is getting a teammate in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever you'd like to get moving, or just answer by email if that's easier.

Best,
Priya
